searchText: Why does https://ethresear.ch redirect me to a GitHub login page now instead of the ethresear.ch login page like it used to? I don't have SSO setup with my GitHub account (nor do I want to). Was this an accidental misconfiguration, or an intentional change? just checked the forum settings. appears to be like that since Jan, 2020. At least thats what the audit logs says. Whats you username on the forums? Thanks for investigating. It does appear I had GitHub OAuth setup. I also vaguely remember complaining about this a while back now that I think about it. I guess I lost the debate. 😆
